Additional Standard Skill.description: May take an additional standard skill normally available, base level 1 if applicable.

Additional Specialist Skill.description: May take an additional specialist skill normally available.

+1 Skill Level.description: Raise one standard skill level by +1; may be bought once per given skill.

+2 Skill Levels From +1 Skill Levels.description: From +1 Skill Level: increase the same standard skill by another +1 (total +2). Once per given skill.

1st Backstab.description: Backstab grants +1 damage grade from behind; applies to helpless targets and H/MP attacks from behind.

Enhanced Draw Venom.description: Draw Venom may be used on any race.

2nd Backstab.description: From 1st Backstab: +2 base damage grades from behind under Backstab conditions.

Utilise Small Shield.description: May use small wooden shields up to 24" diameter despite class restrictions.

Immunity to Sniff.description: Immune to Discern Smell and Locational Sniff.

Potion Stamina 1.description: +6 tblp stamina against potion kick-out damage.

Potion Stamina 2.description: From Potion Stamina 1: total 12 tblp potion kick-out stamina.

Potion Stamina 3.description: From Potion Stamina 2: total 18 tblp potion kick-out stamina.

Discern Potion Kick Out.description: From Discern General Potion: after 30s, can determine a potion’s kick-out.

Enhanced Discern Healing.description: From Discern Healing: gives full details on a healing potion (non-standard at ref’s discretion).

Enhanced Discern Poison.description: From Discern Poison: gives full details on a poison (non-standard at ref’s discretion).

Enhanced Discern General Potion.description: From Discern General: gives full details on a general potion (non-standard at ref’s discretion).

Deeper Study.description: With an extra 30s of Enhanced Evaluate, gain another 7 words of info 1/day.

Minor Prayer.description: 10s prayer acts as one question from Communication I.

Major Prayer.description: 20s prayer acts as one question from Communication II.

Trap Resilience.availability: Available To: 1st Class only Pathfinder Only, any Tomb-Robber Tendency
Trap Resilience.description: Takes only 2/3 damage from triggered traps; cumulative with similar; requires Make & Arm Snap Trap.

Herbal Infusion.availability: Available To: Anyone with 8 levels in Make Healing or Make General, or with the Poisoner tendency
Herbal Infusion.description: Regimen grants +6/2 life and +1 resistance; costs 500 grulls per play; flesh-and-blood effect; Herbalists/Poisoners half cost.

Mercenary Alchemist.description: On-adventure, may make daily temporary potions (good phys reps required) up to weekly make per day; 2 min per batch; in addition to desk makes.

Facility with Armour.description: May wear master-crafted plate if previously able to wear master-crafted chainmail.

Discern Outlaw.availability: Available To: Pathfinder, Assassin, Thug, Spy, anyone with Military Scout Tendency
Discern Outlaw.description: After 10s study, reveals whether a target is outlawed (physical informational effect).

Pick Locks.description: From Lock-Picking standard skill: may now Pick Locks at will.

2nd Backstab (T4).description: From 1st Backstab: +2 base damage grades from behind under Backstab conditions.

Alchemical Specialisation.availability: Available To: Pathfinder, Assassin, anyone with Herbalist Tendency
Alchemical Specialisation.description: +2 levels in one potion-making type (healing/general/poison); other potion-making types halved (round up).

Discern Nature of Trap.description: After 30s inspection, reveals a trap’s power base and likely effects.

+2 Maximum AC.description: From +1 Maximum AC: increase maximum AC to +2 total.

Alchemical Preparation.availability: Available To: Pathfinder, Assassin, anyone with Herbalist Tendency
Alchemical Preparation.description: If 50%+ success chance for a potion, auto-succeeds on half the batches; on play day, may make up to weekly limit in potions in addition.

Backflip.description: As Salmon Leap but only backwards.

Spiritual Vigilance.description: From Spirit-Sense: can perceive spiritual creatures moving within walls/floors; rough outline always visible.

Learned.description: May learn innates up to 3rd level for spells and 2nd level miracles; with Recognise Earth Power, EP innates up to 2nd at 12pts/EP.

A Beating.description: Failed Intimidation vs intended target allows 25% cold rage vs that target if desired.

Archaeologist.description: Gains Read Languages; after 30s studying, 1/day lucky idea about scriptures/writing; if already owned, gains an extra lucky idea.

All Towns are the Same.description: Local Lad benefits apply in any urban environment.

Scraping Up.description: On desk-make + playing same day, failed potion rolls become one-day temp potions; cannot combine with Alchemical Preparation.

Discipline.description: Extra use of basic tendency; +1 resistance vs Domination (not from own military superior).

Part Time Work.description: If master absent, choose a temporary replacement for the adventure; gains on-adventure abilities only.

Wild Danger.description: Gains Danger Sense while in wilds/rural areas and 20’+ from others.

Due Care and Attention.description: With 5 minutes' work, protect one item from the next ‘breaking’ effect; usable at will.

Attuned to the Spirits.description: Applying Holy/Unholy water to own weapons lasts for 2 blows per dose.

Primal Strike.description: Gain a second Primal Strike innate; may apply both to one weapon to inflict Magical and Spiritual (Necro) simultaneously.

Awareness.description: From Combat-Wary: +2 DAC (non-stacking with Blesses/Curses/Watchings etc.).

Resilient Potion-Drinker.availability: Available To: Pathfinder, Thug, Assassin, Beggar, Spy
Resilient Potion-Drinker.description: Potion kick-out stamina returns at 1 tblp per 5 minutes.

3rd Backstab (T7).description: From 2nd Backstab: +3 grades from behind under Backstab conditions.

Surprise Blow.availability: Available To: (1st-class only) Assassin, Pathfinder, Thug, Beggar
Surprise Blow.description: +1 Max Damage (max Quin) using Backstab on first blow from behind, each hand with Either-Handed; affects targets even if immune to Backstab for this max bonus.

Quick Draw Daggers.description: At will, may Time Freeze to draw an O-class Dagger.

Force Majeure (T7).description: Spend Dexterity AC offensively to reduce a single target’s AC by the same amount for 5 minutes (cannot end early). Max 3 purchases.

Torture Mastery.availability: Available To: Assassin, Spy, Kallah Beggar
Torture Mastery.description: If a creature is helpless and can speak, may force 3 truthful answers unless immune to pain; up to 1/hour per target; goodly may not use.

Enhanced Discern Outlaw.availability: Available To: Pathfinder, Assassin, Thug, Spy
Enhanced Discern Outlaw.description: From Discern Outlaw: physical info immunity doesn’t negate unless target has Disguise; cannot combine with Penetrate Disguise.

Change Appearance.description: From Disguise: self-disguise cannot be penetrated by Penetrate Disguise; must be phys-repped to quality.

Penetrate Disguise.description: After 30s observation, detect if a target is disguised and roughly what lies beneath.

Utilise Single Spirit Item.description: May use one personalised spirit item of appropriate alignment; can choose a new one if destroyed.

Unarmed Combat.description: Grants Unarmed Combat as per Warrior.

Acute Hearing.description: Hear creatures within 60’; when used, creatures indicate broad race and location; exceptions at ref’s discretion.

Locational Sniff.description: From Discern Smell: smell creatures within 60’ (race + location); exceptions at ref’s discretion.

+3 Skill Levels.description: From +2 Skill Levels: increase one standard skill by +1 more (total +3). Only in one skill.

Spiritual Adept.description: May use spirit items of own alignment.

Read Spiritual Scrolls.description: From Read Glyphs & Languages: read spiritual scrolls up to half RGL level (round up) of appropriate alignment.

+2 Weapon Mastery (Dagger).description: From +1 Weapon Mastery (Dagger): now +2 masteries with Dagger.

Hero Alchemist.description: From Mercenary Alchemist: on-adventure daily makes equal to skill level per potion branch.

Recovery.description: With 1 hour rest, regain one used innate that is a standard/specialist skill; restrictions apply (e.g., not Spy neuronic innates).

Pre-Prepared.description: From Hero/Mercenary Alchemist: may start adventure with some/all batches pre-made.

Two Isn’t as Good as One.description: If using a B-class weapon, Surprise/Greater Surprise Blows apply to first two blows instead of first with E-class.

Well-Equipped with Healing.availability: Available To: Thug, Pathfinder, anyone with Herbalist Tendency
Well-Equipped with Healing.description: Begin adventure with 3 doses of adventure-temp 6pt tblp cure potions.

Well-Equipped with Venom.availability: Available To: Assassin, Thug, Kallah Beggar, Herbalist Tendency
Well-Equipped with Venom.description: Begin adventure with 3 doses of adventure-temp BV 6 potions.

Utilise Earth Power Items.availability: Available To: Pathfinder, Dabbler, Spy, anyone with Loner tendency
Utilise Earth Power Items.description: From Recognise Earth Power: may use Earth Power items like a Druid.

Utilise Neuronic Items.description: From Recognise Neuronics: may use Neuronic items like a Neuronic class.

Cache.availability: Available To: Pathfinder, Assassin, Thug, Tinker Tendency
Cache.description: Begin with an adventure-temp simple bomb (tennis-ball rep). On detonation: 18 tblp (3 to each loc) in 20’ (reduced only by innate PAC at 6/1). One use.

Solitaire.description: If carrying no permanent supernatural items (except elven enchanted), immune to supernatural sights; breaks for 15 min if attacking or running.

Spiritually Cloaked.description: From Immunity to Informational Miracles: immune to spiritual informational effects (Recognise Spirit still Yes/No).

Magically Cloaked.description: From Immunity to Informational Spells: immune to magical informational effects (Recognise Mana still Yes/No).

Force Majeure (T8).description: As Assassin Table 7 Force Majeure; only when wielding daggers. Max 2 purchases.

Supernatural Perception.description: From Perception: may use it vs any target (supernatural or physical).

Standard Skill.description: May take a pathfinder standard skill not normally available (class restrictions still apply).

Specialist Skill.description: May take a pathfinder specialist skill not normally available (class restrictions still apply).

Dirty Fighter.description: +6 damage from behind; requires Backstab 1st, +1 Weapon Mastery, +1 Strength; doesn’t change max damage; doesn’t stack with Veteran Fighter.

Enhanced +2 Weapon Mastery.description: From +1 Weapon Mastery: now +2 Masteries in one nominated weapon type.

Greater Change Appearance.availability: Available To: (1st Class Only) Assassin, Spy, Pathfinder
Greater Change Appearance.description: From Change Appearance: no need for base race makeup; quality/quantity of disguise makeup must still match restrictions.

Greater Surprise Blows.availability: Available To: (1st-class only) Thug, Assassin, Pathfinder, Beggar
Greater Surprise Blows.description: From Surprise Blow: using Backstab, +X max damage on the first blow (X = Backstab grades). Doesn’t apply if target immune to Backstab.

Greater Stealth.availability: Available To: Thug, Assassin, Pathfinder, Beggar
Greater Stealth.description: From Stealth: 1/day move at slow zombie speed without breaking Stealth; still breaks on other violations.

3rd Backstab (T9).description: From 2nd Backstab: +3 grades from behind under Backstab conditions.

Non-Academis.description: From 5th Extra Level of Life: grants 6th Extra Level of Life; not if in any bracket bar Warrior.

Incendiary Cache.availability: Available To: Pathfinder, Assassin, Thug, anyone with Tinker Tendency
Incendiary Cache.description: As Cache, but explosion deals 12/2 non-supernatural flaming damage in 20’ (only innate PAC reduces); objects in radius Ignite.

Blinding Cache.availability: Available To: Pathfinder, Assassin, Thug, anyone with Tinker Tendency
Blinding Cache.description: As Cache, but causes a bright flash; blinds visible targets in 20’ for 2 min (Immunity to Blindness applies); no damage.

Accuracy.description: First blow of combat cuts through PAC.

First Aid.description: Grants Pathfinder Monk Locational Curing as per Monk.

Tampering.availability: Available To: Pathfinder, Assassin, Thug, anyone with Tinker Tendency
Tampering.description: Modify a Cache to detonate at a set delay (2s to 5m) after impact; requires 30s of ‘fiddling’.

Ghost.description: From appropriate informational immunity: cross corresponding supernatural lines/wards at ≤½ speed and with awareness; doesn’t cross impenetrable barriers.

Killer’s Eye.availability: Available To: 1st Class Any, 2nd Class Assassin
Killer’s Eye.description: From Assassin’s Eye: reveals Supernatural hits if relevant Recognise skill is owned; becomes informational effect of that power base.

Enhanced Judge Strength.description: From Judge Strength: reveals target’s supernatural resist levels if appropriate Recognise is owned; counts as that power base informational effect.

Enhanced Judge Profession.availability: Available To: 1st Class Any, 2nd Class Spy
Enhanced Judge Profession.description: From Judge Profession: becomes informational effect for any power base with a Recognise skill.

An Eye to a Kill.description: After using Judge Strength, Judge Profession, Assassin’s Eye: +3 Backstab on first blow vs that target within 30s; 1/day; max 4 purchases.

Great Cache.availability: Available To: Pathfinder, Assassin, Thug, anyone with Tinker Tendency
Great Cache.description: As Cache but larger: 36/6 physical in 20’, plus Knockback/Knockdown; may cause structural damage.

Ambush.availability: Available To: (1st Class) Assassin, Pathfinder, Kallah Beggars
Ambush.description: First blow from behind gains +1 damage grade (within max).

Greater Ambush.availability: Available To: (1st Class) Assassin, Pathfinder, Kallah Beggars
Greater Ambush.description: Ambush now applies to first blow of each hand; bracket limits apply.

Strike Death Blow.description: After 10s concentration, may slay a valid unconscious/helpless flesh-and-blood target susceptible to your damage type.

Streetwise.description: After 5s at ≤9’, discern if a target is Evil (physical informational effect).

Specialist.availability: Available To: 1st Class Assassin or Kallah Caste Beggar, or 1st Class Any with buy as Assassin.
Specialist.description: May inflict max damage of Quin from behind; Surprise Blow based on Quin; non-behind blows max Triple unless also Warrior bracket.

+ 3 DAC for Force Majeure.description: +3 DAC usable only for Force Majeure.

+ 6 (from +3) DAC for Force Majeure.description: +6 DAC usable only for Force Majeure.

Sense Motion.description: From multiple perception abilities and DAC 7+: aware of movement of all creatures within 20’; watch moving targets.

Even Greater Stealth.availability: Available To: (1st-class only) Thug, Assassin, Pathfinder, Beggar
Even Greater Stealth.description: With at least 2 Greater Stealths: Greater Stealth becomes ‘at will’ (still only applies to Stealth innates).

Super Ghost.availability: Available To: All 1st Class bar Thug
Super Ghost.description: From Ghost: may cross warding barriers under same conditions.

Super Solitaire.availability: Available To: (1st-class only) Pathfinder, Thug, Assassin, Beggar, Spy
Super Solitaire.description: From Solitaire: immune to chosen power source only when not carrying items of that source.

3rd Backstab (T10).description: From 2nd Backstab: +3 grades from behind under Backstab conditions.

Cascade.description: From Greater Surprise Blows: Surprise Blow applies to the second blow of each hand; interacts with Two Isn’t as Good as One.

Magical Concealment.availability: Available To: 1st Class Pathfinder, Spy, Rogue
Magical Concealment.description: From Magically Cloaked & Solitaire: while under (Greater) Stealth, immune to magical/elemental sights for 5 min; 1/day; max 3.

Spiritual Concealment.availability: Available To: 1st Class Pathfinder, Spy, Wayfinder
Spiritual Concealment.description: From Spiritually Cloaked & Solitaire: while under (Greater) Stealth, immune to spiritual sights for 5 min; 1/day; max 3.

Calculated Strike.availability: Available To: 1st Class Assassin and Kallah.
Calculated Strike.description: After Assassin’s Eye, Judge Strength, Judge Profession, study 30s: Surprise/Greater Surprise max damage applies even vs Backstab-immune; physical informational, 20’ range; Scout/Warrior brackets only; max 3.

Immunity to Perception.availability: Available To: (1st-class only) Pathfinder, Assassin, Spy
Immunity to Perception.description: From Ghost & Immunity to Physical Informational Effects: immune to Perception except Wanderer’s Hunch and Sense Motion.

Stealthy.availability: Available To: (1st-class only) Thug, Assassin, Pathfinder, Beggar
Stealthy.description: From Even Greater Stealth: applies to any form of own innate ‘chameleon’; not from items.

Enhanced Super Ghost.availability: Available To: 1st Class ALL Bar Thug
Enhanced Super Ghost.description: From Super Ghost: need not be aware of wardings crossed; still move at ≤½ speed.

4th Backstab.availability: Available To: (1st Class Only) Assassin, Kallah Beggars
4th Backstab.description: From 3rd Backstab: +4 grades from behind under Backstab conditions.

Master Ambush.availability: Available To: (1st Class) Assassin, Pathfinder, Kallah Beggars
Master Ambush.description: From Greater Ambush: +2 grades on first blow and +1 on second.

View to a Kill.availability: Available To: (1st-class only) Assassin, Kallah Beggar
View to a Kill.description: With at least 4 Eye to a Kill innates: may use at will, max once per target per day.

Master Solitaire.description: From Super Solitaire: while under (Greater) Stealth, Solitaire applies regardless of carried items if immune to that power base’s informational effects.

First Cut is the Deepest.description: From Greater Surprise Blows & Cascade: No Max Damage First Strike from behind; next two blows are Greater Surprise, fourth and fifth are Surprise; requires 60s study; bracket limits apply.

5th Backstab.description: From 4th Backstab: +5 grades from behind under Backstab conditions.

Hidden Assailant.availability: Available To: (1st Class only) Pathfinder, Assassin
Hidden Assailant.description: From Immunity to Perception: immune to Wanderer’s Hunch and Sense Motion while under Stealth/Chameleon and stationary; drops for 5 min if you attack.

Bully Boy.availability: Class-dependent; see Tendency Costs and Availability by Class matrix.
Bully Boy.description: Violent, brutality-inclined scout. May only be in Warrior bracket; extra life +1/1 (max 5/2); gains Intimidation (Cause Fear after 10s, 2/day); Max AC 9; can buy Warrior subclass abilities 4 tables lower; immune to Stunning Blows; 25% discount to multi-class Warrior.

Chirurgeon.availability: Requires ≥8 levels in Make Healing Potion. Class-dependent costs; see matrix.
Chirurgeon.description: Healer-specialist. Gains Tell Wounds/Poison/Disease (Druid; 2s if already owned), Monk Locational Healing (bandaging heals equal tblp), knows Treated/Medicated Bandages, +2 levels Make Healing (max 12), Healing Facility (or 1-minute assisted admin), Bandaging also heals 1 tblp, 33% discount on multi-class Very Well Equipped: Healing.

Cutthroat.availability: Evil only. Class-dependent costs; see matrix.
Cutthroat.description: Murder-focused. Ostracised in Empire; +1 cumulative Backstab (max 3); +2 Stealth innates/day; +1 Greater Stealth/day; Vicious Strike 1/day (non-level stunning on a damaging blow); Stunning Blow innates become Vicious Strike; Murderer’s Eye 1/day (Judge Str/Prof, Tell Wounds, Assassin’s Eye after 30s @ 9'); gains Assassin’s Eye (or faster 15s @ 18' if owned); may buy Surprise/Greater Surprise Blows as 1st-Class Assassin (or one table earlier if already eligible).

Dabbler.description: Jack-of-all-trades. Multi-class only within Scout bracket (counts as 6 tables lower for non-Scout abilities). With Rec Mana+RGL: buy 1/2mp innates of basic colours (10pts/pt), Detect Magic at will (1 tblp), cast level = RGL. With Rec Spirit+RGL: buy 1sp basic miracles (12pts/pt) and use one aligned spirit item; still use magic while carrying metal, and spirit while holding sharp/magical items. With Rec EP: may use EP items. With Rec Neuronics: buy Neural Foci as neuronic, and utilise neuronic item. +1 level to all Scout standard skills (max 6). Pick two priestly discerns. Use Spiritual Items of Own Alignment costs 100 (not 150). Half-Spirit doesn’t double costs on innates granted here.

Henchman.availability: Must name a single master (see rules). Class-dependent costs; see matrix.
Henchman.description: +1 Strength for carry/lift (not combat); assists master at desk (+1 skill to potions; +10% normal scrolls; −5% on item Failure Table and shares detriments). With master on adventure: +1 resistance to master’s power base (or physical), +6/2 life, +1 DAC, Sixth Sense within 20'. Beneficial effects from master cost −1 power (non-stacking). +2 resistance to domination generally, but −2 vs master.

Herbalist.availability: Requires total ≥8 skill levels across potion types. Class-dependent costs; see matrix.
Herbalist.description: Alchemist-savvy. Buy potion recipes at ½ cost; +1 level to all potion making; Discern Plant Type at will; may buy Immunity to Poison/Acid at ½ cost; generally improved information from potion/plant discerns (ref’s discretion).

Killer.description: Death-focused. Only in Warrior bracket; may buy Weapon Masteries and Mighty Strikes as Warrior. Innates: Adept with Weapons 1/day (gain 1st mastery in a chosen weapon for the day), Primal Strike 1/day (magic or spirit damage for 5 mins). Lucky Idea 1/day about how to kill someone.

Local Lad / Lass.availability: Choose a specific settlement. Class-dependent costs; see matrix.
Local Lad / Lass.description: Urban specialist. In own settlement: after 5 min out of LoS may ‘vanish’ (leave and optionally return after 15 min); Rumour Lore (Comm II-like) about city/Empire events; non-magical Chameleon 1/day (no max) in urban areas; up to 600G of immediate standard potions 1/day pre- or mid-adventure (own settlement); gains Shadowing & Perception (or upgrades to Enhanced Tracking / Supernatural Perception) in urban areas.

Loner.description: Wilderness scout. Gains Survival; Druidic Discern Plant/Animal at will; non-magical Chameleon 1/day outdoors (no max); Tracking (or Enhanced Tracking) outdoors; Perception (or Supernatural Perception) outdoors; Immunity to Cold (natural) and ½ vs supernatural cold; innate Physical AC 1; outdoors: after 5 min out of LoS may vanish (leave adventure; cannot return). Only one social guild.

Military Scout.availability: May enter only Warrior or Wizard brackets. Optional Legion alignment. Class-dependent costs; see matrix.
Military Scout.description: Benefits include official Legion papers (tamper-proof); armour supplied; Hollow Tooth 100G covered (+ free keyed insta-kill venom); max damage Quin with MP weapons (Six on T8, Seven on T10); +1 stacking MP mastery; Survival (or 3 levels Well-Equipped if already owned); buy MP masteries as Warrior; Discipline 2/day (ignore Fear/Emotion/Domination unless from own superior); may coat two arrows/bolts with one dose of blade venom.

Ninja (Magical).availability: Amlesian Human Assassin, Evil, Lawful; requires Recognise Mana. Class-dependent costs; see matrix.
Ninja (Magical).description: Identity/alignment masked (always reads Neutral). Choose this path at purchase. Gains Read Languages & Read Glyphs at 6 levels (or +3 each, max 12); add up to 12 mana of standard magical innates (any level; casting damage per scroll skill); can cast by 10s silent focus instead of verbals; may buy standard spell innates at 10 pts/mana up to post-8th table threshold; no longer ‘pure’; may only enter Wizard bracket; metal restrictions as Rogue.

Ninja (Neuronic).availability: Amlesian Human Assassin, Evil, Lawful; requires Recognise Neuronics. Class-dependent costs; see matrix.
Ninja (Neuronic).description: Identity/alignment masked (reads Neutral). Gains +3 Neural Foci; Neuronic Chameleon 1/day; Neuro Mastery 2/day; may buy Neural Foci as neuronic; may buy Neuro Mastery at will for 100pts on Table 8; utilise neuronic item; no longer ‘pure’; may only enter Neuronic bracket; potion restrictions as Psi-Master.

Poisoner.availability: Requires ≥8 levels in Make Poison; not Goodly. Class-dependent costs; see matrix.
Poisoner.description: +2 levels Make Poison (max 12); buy poison recipes at ½ cost; no 1/300pts limit on poison recipes; Poison Facility (or improved to any location if owned); split one BV dose across two daggers (−2 grades each); gains Distillation & Potion Preserving for Make Poison (no extra grull if already owned); 50% off baneful poison attacks; Immunity to Poison at ½ cost; Herbal Infusion at 50% off; Very Well Equipped: Poison at 33% discount.

Super Dabbler.availability: From Dabbler. Class-dependent costs; see matrix.
Super Dabbler.description: May multi-class to any published class partially within the Scout bracket (ignoring usual two-bracket limits) but counts as 6 tables lower for non-Scout abilities; for other tendencies/Scout abilities, counts as only in Scout bracket.

Temple Assassin.availability: Choose a religion of appropriate alignment. Class-dependent costs; see matrix.
Temple Assassin.description: Lay Believer of chosen faith; innate True Believer; start with 10 spirits of standard scrolls (dungeon-temp) from church base list; may claim guild benefits from church; excommunication removes all benefits; may only multi-class into Priest bracket.

Tinker.description: Technically minded. Shatter normal objects (30s prep) at will; Mend/straighten (2 min with tools) at will; Lucky Idea 1/day (objects/problems); never lose armour uses; Blade-Sharpening on own gear lasts 3 blows; Improvisation (5 min foraging) to make makeshift weapon; buff master-crafted armour vs Accuracy; 2/day Shatter blow vs normal object (after 10s observe); 25% discount on Very Well Equipped options; buy Cache as if 1000 pts higher; begin with one of: trusty indestructible weapon / standard Cache / 400G of immediately available/simple potions (adventure-temp, no cards).

Tomb Robber.description: Burglary & traps expert. Discern Nature of Undead at will (Priest; or physical if spiritless); Relaxed Fall; identify a located trap’s effect after 10s (approximate without relevant Recognise); Enhanced Evaluate (30s) for artefacts with warnings on detriments (ref’s discretion); Danger Sense (5s focus; ref’s discretion; passive warnings when >20’ from allies); Trap-Wary (or take no damage from area effect on half-effect).
